The file name is shown as id_rsa in tutorials and the submit page but mine is different?

posts.name: Devam Shah
posts.cooked:
Don’t worry, both are names of different algorithms for generating ssh-keys, ed25519 is better for modern choices, rsa is also valid but compatible with when older systems are concerned.

So both are valid rsa OR ed25519.

To know more about algorithm
  • Ed25519 :
    • Security : Ed25519 provides a high level of security with a smaller key size. It is based on elliptic curve cryptography (ECC) and is considered as secure as RSA with a 3000-bit key, despite being much shorter.
    • Performance : Ed25519 is faster than RSA in terms of key generation and signature verification, leading to quicker logins and a smoother user experience.
    • Key Size : Ed25519 keys are significantly smaller than RSA keys. An Ed25519 public key is only 68 characters long, compared to RSA’s 3072 characters.
    • Robustness : Ed25519 is more robust against pseudo-random number generator (PRNG) failures, which can be a security risk for RSA.
  • RSA :
    • Security : RSA is well-known and has been the standard for SSH keys for many years. To be considered secure, RSA keys must be at least 2048 bits long, and 4096-bit keys are recommended for better security.
    • Performance : RSA operations, especially with larger key sizes, can be slower than those of Ed25519, leading to longer login times and a less responsive user experience.
    • Compatibility : RSA is widely supported and recognized, making it a better choice for compatibility with older systems.

Thank you.
